jobs.title: Cyber Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Deloitte's Cyber team helps our clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape. We simplify complexity, and enable businesses to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage their security posture.  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.  
  
**The Team:**  
  
Deloitte's Cyber Engineering is a new team that is spearheading the buildout of Cybersecurity technology that will underpin the next generation of our Cybersecurity services. Join us as we work with technologies shaping the future of Cybersecurity to build future capabilities today.  
  
**Position Summary**  
  
Join Deloitte's Cyber Engineering team to help build technology that supports the next generation of cybersecurity services. As a Full Stack Engineer, you will design, develop, and enhance applications across frontend and backend environments, working with modern engineering practices and cloud-based technologies. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions that support client and business needs.  
  
**Work you'll do**  
  
As a Full Stack Engineer on the Cyber Engineering team, you will be responsible for...  

* Collaborating with business stakeholders, engineers, and team leadership to translate business needs into technical solutions
* Designing, developing, testing, and enhancing full stack applications across frontend and backend technologies
* Building and integrating application programming interfaces, microservices, and cloud-based services to support product functionality
* Supporting product quality through code reviews, testing, debugging, and continuous integration and continuous deployment practices
* Contributing to technical analysis, solution design, and delivery activities that support client outcomes and product development

  
A successful candidate would possess these skills:  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

  
**Qualifications**  
  
Required:  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, or a similar technical field
* 2-3+ years experience in the following areas:
* + 2-3+ years of experience in full stack development across frontend and backend technologies, including experience with Angular, React, or Next.js and JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3
  + 2-3+ years of experience in backend development using Node.js, Python with Django or Flask, or Java with Spring Boot
  + 2-3+ years of experience building and consuming Representational State Transfer application programming interfaces and working with microservices or serverless architectures in production environments
  + 2-3+ years of experience working with relational databases and at least 1 NoSQL database, and using Git, Azure DevOps or similar tools, Docker, Agile or Scrum methods, automated testing, and continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines
  + 1-3+ years of experience developing, integrating, or deploying artificial intelligence, Generative AI, or agentic AI solutions within enterprise applications on Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
* Ability to travel 20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

  
Preferred:  

* Experience with object-oriented programming, design patterns, and clean coding practices
* Experience building secure, reusable, responsive, and maintainable applications
* Experience with secure development practices, DevOps, DevSecOps, web security, GitOps, or Kubernetes customization
* Experience with OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, Neo4j, Memgraph, Maven, or Gradle
* Experience with Bootstrap, jQuery, or JavaServer Pages in legacy or mixed-technology environments
* Cloud certification in Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform

  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $100,400 to $197,900.  
  
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.  
  
#LI-DT6

**Who We Are:**

Ever wonder who brings the entertainment to your flights? Panasonic Avionics Corporation is #1 in the industry for delivering inflight products such as movies, games, Wi-Fi, and now Bluetooth headphone connectivity!

How exciting would it be to be a part of the innovation that goes into creating technology that delights millions of people in an industry that’s here to stay! With our company’s history spanning over 40 years, you will have stability, career growth opportunities, and will work with the brightest minds in the industry.

If you want to learn more about us, visit us at www.panasonic.aero. And for a full listing of open job opportunities go to https://careers.na.panasonic.com/avionics/jobs

**The position:**

We are seeking a Member of Technical Staff III (MTS III) Software Engineer with strong experience in C++ and Python backend development to join the Panasonic Avionics team.

The successful candidate will design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain backend services and REST APIs supporting production software platforms. This role requires strong software engineering fundamentals, hands-on development experience, and the ability to build reliable, scalable, and maintainable services.

The engineer will work closely with other software engineers, architects, DevOps engineers, product teams, and other technical stakeholders to deliver backend capabilities from design through production deployment and operational support.

* Participate in software design and architecture discussions and contribute to technical decisions.

* Debug and troubleshoot complex software issues across development, test, and production environments.

* Contribute to technical documentation, API documentation, software design documentation, and operational procedures.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering best practices across the development team.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Strong professional software development experience with C++ and Python.
* Strong experience designing and developing RESTful APIs and backend services.
* Strong understanding of object-oriented software design, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns.
* Experience developing multi-threaded or concurrent applications and understanding performance and resource-management considerations.
* Experience developing software for Linux-based environments.
* Debugging & Diagnostics: Hands-on experience troubleshooting issues using standard Linux diagnostic tools (strace, lsof, netstat, journalctl, dmesg)
* Experience designing, debugging, testing, and maintaining production software.
* Experience with automated unit and integration testing for C++ and Python applications.
* Experience with source control and collaborative development workflows using Git.
* Experience with automated build, integration, and deployment processes using CI/CD pipelines.
* Understanding of API design principles including versioning, validation, error handling, authentication, and backward compatibility.
* Experience working with relational and/or NoSQL databases.
* Experience troubleshooting distributed applications and diagnosing issues across multiple services and system components.
* Strong understanding of software security, reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly.
* Demonstrated ability to independently own software features from technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers across multiple disciplines and mentor less-experienced developers.

**OTHER REQUIREMENTS:**

* Ability to travel to domestic or international locations as required, up to 10% of the time.

jobs.title: Associate Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Position Description:

Valiant Solutions is hiring an **Associate Software Engineer** to build the internal apps, automations, and AI tools that help our staff work faster.

The **Associate Software Engineer** will work directly with people across the company to find slow or error-prone work, then design, build, and measure the fix. Much of this work runs through VITALs (Valiant Innovation Team and Lab), our program that turns staff ideas into custom apps and automations. Inside IT and Engineering, you work alongside the Engineering lead and the IT Systems Administrator. The Engineering lead sets technical direction and priorities. The IT Systems Administrator runs daily IT operations, user support, and software licenses. You build the apps, automations, and AI tools that make the team, and the rest of Valiant, more efficient. All three roles share one backlog and review work together, so ideas move quickly from a support ticket or staff interview to a working tool.

Named one of the**Best Places to Work** **in the Washington DC area for 12 consecutive years**, Valiant is proud of our employee-centric culture and commitment to excellence. If you are interested in learning more about Valiant and this opportunity, we invite you to apply now!

**Location:** This position allows for 100% remote work. ***Remote work requires a high level of trust in our employees, and we strictly adhere to the details outlined in our Remote Work Policy below.***

**Eligibility:** Must be legally authorized to work in the United States

**Required qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field or equivalent experience. 0 to 2 years of experience. Internships and substantial projects count.
* Working skill in TypeScript, JavaScript, or Python.
* An app, tool, or automation you built that other people used.
* Working knowledge of RESTAPIs, OAuth 2.0, Git, and the Linux command line. Clear communication with technical and non-technical people, in writing and in conversation.
* Ability to learn how a team works, find where it slows down, and plan the fix. Self-direction in a fully remote team.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Google Cloud or another major cloud, plus Docker.
* Next.js or React.
* Workflow automation tools, such as n8n, Make.com, or Google Apps Script. LLM APIs, agents, MCP servers, orAI coding tools such as Claude Code. Google Workspace administration or GAM.
* IT support experience.
* Experience training users or running user acceptance testing.

**Responsibilities:**

Your core work is building software, automation, and AI tools that give Valiant staff time back. When IT gets busy, you also help the team with escalations.

**Build and ship**

* Develop projects from the VITALs backlog, from project charter and definition of done through sprints, launch, and measurement.
* Build and maintain apps on our internal Micro-App Platform for finance, contracts, HR, and other internal teams.
* Move workflows out of low-code apps and into custom apps when they outgrow them.
* Work with the IT Systems Administrator to further automate IT tasks and management, from account provisioning and offboarding to Google Workspace administration and reporting.
* Build and maintain integrations between our business systems.
* Run user acceptance testing with each app's users, and confirm every app works on real tasks before launch.
* Ship through GitHub with code review, CI, tests, and a runbook for each release.

**AI development and enablement**

* Help set Valiant's AI development strategy: where AI fits, how we evaluate it, and how we deploy it securely.
* Build AI features, agents, and automations with LLM APIs and MCP servers, then measure the results against the manual baseline.
* Test new AI models and tools as they release, and recommend what Valiant adopts. Advise Valiant on modern AI tools and research, such as Claude Code and ChatGPT, and keep the company current as the field changes. Your recommendations inform adoption and risk decisions by the CTO and Engineering lead.
* Train staff to use AI tools well through sessions, written guides, and one-on-one help.

**Discover and plan**

* Meet with staff and department leads to learn how their work gets done. Find the slow, manual, or error-prone steps in their workflows, and turn them into scoped plans with a measured baseline.
* Keep exploring new ways technology can improve how Valiant works, and bring forward the ideas worth testing.
* Contribute to the project that defines Valiant's future app architecture, including how apps share data, sign users in, and connect to business systems.

**Tools you may work with.** These are examples, not requirements. Our tools change as Valiant grows, and you learn most of them on the job.

* **App development:** TypeScript, Next.js, React, Node.js, Python
* **Cloud and hosting:** Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Compute Engine, Firestore), Docker, Linux
* **Automation:** n8n, Make.com, Google Apps Script, Bash, GAM
* **Business systems:** Google Workspace, Unanet, Salesforce, GoDaddy, iCIMS, Knack, Notion, Discord, Supernormal
* **Source control and CI:** GitHub, GitHub Actions

**Growth and milestones**

This role is built to grow. The apps you build become yours to own: you set their roadmap, work directly with the people who use them, and decide how they improve. As your track record grows, so does your scope, from single features to whole platforms, and from building tools to shaping how Valiant builds them.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Multimedia & Multimodal AI
jobs.description:
Applied AI (AAI) is Meta’s organization focused on making our AI models best-in-class, starting with coding. Within AAI, the Multimedia & MultiModality team covers the multimedia domain across every modality, on both the input and the output side of a model: image, video, audio, speech and music. We work directly with research, model-training and engineering partners across MSL, TBD and FAIR. Current problems include evaluating video experiences, diagnosing multimedia model behavior, producing domain-expert agent tasks, and building the data and measurement pipelines multimodal capabilities are trained and judged against.About the roleWe are hiring a senior engineer to lead this work end to end. You will take a modality or a capability area, decide what data is worth producing and how it should be measured, and carry it from an open question through to a pipeline that runs and a measurement the org relies on.This is a multimodal role, not a text-only role. You will work across image, video, audio and speech, as model inputs and as model outputs, and the data and evaluations you own will cover media, not text alone.You will choose where the pod invests, own outcomes beyond your individual contribution, set standards other engineers build against, and raise quality without becoming the review bottleneck.  
  
  

### **Software Engineer, Multimedia & Multimodal AI Responsibilities:**

* Set technical direction for a modality or capability area.
* Determining where the team invests, what success means, and the tradeoffs behind both.
* Drive that direction across partner teams, not just inside your own.
* Design and build agentic workflows and pipelines, including human-in-the-loop and expert-in-the-loop designs, to automate data production and scale output past what manual authoring supports.
* Design and own data pipelines at scale: ingestion, filtering, pseudo-labeling and captioning with attribute classifiers, and provenance tracking for audio corpora.
* Build evaluation infrastructure: objective metrics (speaker/style similarity, codec and generator quality), human listening-test pipelines, and the correlation analysis that ties the two together.
* Improve training efficiency and reliability — distributed training, GPU utilization, codec and tokenizer retraining, experiment management.
* Reproduce and extend state-of-the-art research: implement new methods from papers into our codebases and run rigorous ablations.
* Mentor engineers on the team, contribute to hiring and onboarding, and raise the bar on evaluation and quality practice.
* Build and train generative and representation models for speech, sound, and music — including text-, audio-, and video-conditioned generation, infilling, editing, and style transfer.

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 3+ years building ML systems in production or research settings
* strong Python and PyTorch
* Demonstrated experience with speech, audio, or music ML - ASR, TTS, audio codecs, music information retrieval, self-supervised audio representation learning, or audio generative modeling
* Experience with large-scale data pipelines and distributed training
* Track record of translating research ideas into working, measurable systems

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Publications at top venues (ICASSP, Interspeech, ISMIR, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) in speech, audio, or music
* Generative modeling of continuous data (diffusion / flow matching, audio or vision), and demonstrated ability to switch domains and ramp quickly
* Audio DSP depth — pitch detection, FFT, real-time signal processing
* Experience with disentangled or controllable generation (voice, emotion, style, instrumentation)
* Experience building evaluation harnesses and human-eval pipelines for generative audio
* Music domain expertise: stem separation, mixing, lyrics/vocal conditioning
* Experience designing benchmarks or evaluations for model capability, with attention to grading reliability, reproducibility and label quality
* Experience building data pipelines for image, video, audio, speech or complex media formats, including versioning, lineage and provenance
* Experience designing AI agents, orchestration, or human-in-the-loop systems
* Hands-on experience evaluating or red-teaming multimodal models, or creating the data used to improve them
* Understanding of Responsible AI practices and building quality controls into AI output
* Experience with zero-to-one work: forming a charter and standing up process while priorities are still moving
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status

jobs.title: Scientific Software Engineer - Meteorological Decoders for Observation Processing and Integration
jobs.description:
Overview:

Lynker is seeking a highly skilled Software Engineer to support the NOAA/NWS Office of Modeling and Development by managing, developing, and optimizing the meteorological data decoder systems. This role focuses on the critical pipeline that converts diverse, native-format meteorological observations into standardized formats required for downstream numerical weather prediction (NWP) systems.

Responsibilities:

**Duties of the Scientific Software Engineer will include the following:**

**Technical Operations & R&D**

  

* Develop, maintain, and optimize C and Fortran programs used to decode raw meteorological bulletins.

  

* Translate non-standard native data formats into BUFR and JEDI IODA netcdf by engineering specialized decoder logic

  

* Ensure uninterrupted, efficient data flow by managing input and output streams for ingest data queues, descriptor lists, and temporary BUFR message storage.

**Systems & Data Integration**

  

* Monitor and troubleshoot operational data ingestion across major meteorological data servers, including LDM, DBNet, GTS, and WIS2.

  

* Ensure decoded data tanks are optimized for rapid assimilation into the NCEP NWP system, supporting the generation of thousands of daily weather products.

  

* Manage and maintain the software repositories pertaining to legacy and operational decoder processing.

**Coordination & Reporting**

  

* Liaise with upstream data originators and downstream NCO Operations users to seamlessly integrate new observational data types into the BUFR pipeline.

  

* Report on software task progress, system performance metrics, and project risks to the Lead Scientist and Federal oversight managers.

  

* Participate in the Modernization of Observation Infrastructure project (GEODE) to transition legacy decoder frameworks to modern architectures.

Qualifications:

**The Scientist Software Engineer selected for this role should meet the following qualifications:**

  

* Advanced skills and knowledge of Fortran and C programming languages specifically tailored for data parsing and processing.

  

* Deep understanding of **BUFR** (Binary Universal Form for the Representation of meteorological data), including table-driven descriptors and binary extraction logic.

  

* Experience working in a UNIX/Linux environment with advanced shell scripting languages.

  

* Demonstrated knowledge of meteorological data servers and distribution networks (LDM, DBNet, GTS, WIS2).

  

* Skills and knowledge of High-Performance Computing (HPC) file systems and job schedulers (e.g., WCOSS environment, MPI, Slurm, LSF).

  

* Knowledge of modern software development practices and version control software, particularly Git/GitHub/Gitflow.

  

* Ability to perform complex, mission-critical debugging in a fast-paced, operational environment.

**Additional desirable experiences and skills include:**

  

* Knowledge of global Data Assimilation (DA) systems and observation networks.
* Experience transitioning legacy meteorological codebases into Cloud environments.
* Background in atmospheric physics or earth system modeling.

**About Lynker**

Lynker is a growing, employee owned business, specializing in professional, scientific and technical services. Our continually expanding team combines scientific expertise with mature, results-driven processes and tools to achieve technically sound, cost effective solutions in hydrology/water sciences, geospatial analysis, information technology, resource management, conservation, and management and business process improvement.

We focus on putting the right people in the right place to be effective. And having the right people is critical for success. Our streamlined organization enables and empowers our talented professionals to tackle our customers' scientific and technical priorities – creatively and effectively.

Lynker offers a team-oriented work environment, and the opportunity to work in a culture of exceptionally skilled professionals who embrace sound science and creative solutions. Lynker's benefits include the following:

* Comprehensive healthcare for the employee at no monthly cost
* Healthcare benefit covers medical, prescription drug, dental, and vision
* Personal Time Off (PTO) Policy plus paid holidays
* Highly competitive compensation plan regularly calibrated against industry and location benchmarks
* 401(k) retirement plan with company-matching
* Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) – we're all company owners!
* Flexible spending accounts
* Employee assistance program (EAP)
* Short- and long-term disability insurance
* Life and accident insurance
* Tuition assistance/Training/Workforce improvement reimbursement per year
* Spot bonuses for exceptional performance
* Annual Employee Recognition Awards with bonuses
* Employee Referral Program
* Free centralized, self-directed Learning Management System to learn at your own pace
* Personalized career growth plans for every employee

**Lynker is an E-Verify employer.**

**Lynker is an equal opportunity employer and makes all employment decisions based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local laws**.
